notes.title: New Game Announced and More
notes.notes:
Hello Steam Community,

It's been a while, but we have some fun news for you. We're announcing our new game Press A For Achievements.

It's a mini-game collection where players earn achievements, coins and gifts by simply pressing A.

Watch the trailer below:
[previewyoutube=DYP2DLJNtGk;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Nippon Characters Return in Press A For Achievements[/h2]
In this game some of your favourite Nippon Marathon characters make a return.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36800165/6db6b52a86647df479420f8bb25c6606d255efb8.gif[/img]
Race across the desert as Nishibori in the Nippon Kart minigame

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36800165/71e5c19ae73b3daf353858be4e8ce59bd0a188ea.gif[/img]
Control Abe Watanabe as he presents the news

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36800165/38f23a34d43ecf00f94f6b6eeea46441edb29d88.gif[/img]
Help Snuguru put the exact amount of fuel in the car

It's a fun and crazy game as you'd expect and you can find out more and wishlist the game now on the Steam Store.

Wishlist here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659150/Press_A_For_Achievements/]Press A For Achievements on Steam[/url]

[h1]
NFTs on OpenSea[/h1]
To celebrate the announcement we're also making a collection of one-of-a-kind NFTs available. This BOSS collection features the new Nippon Marathon 2 in-game models of Hazuki, Hideko, Felix and KG Park. Other collections will be made available in the future.

Don't worry, we'll never include any kind of NFT within one of our games, but to help raise funds for the continued development of Nippon Marathon 2 we're putting this artwork on OpenSea. That way fans can enjoy the artwork and help fund the continued development of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36800165/a88f6da593c25fa62463083b335c83fe8692cb0f.png[/img]

See how cool they are?

We'll be creating NFTs for all our future characters, not just for Nippon Marathon 2 but for anything else too, so if you're digging the whole NFT scene these might just be worth collecting!

This is a chance to get in on the ground floor 🙂

Handsome Hazuki - Auction starts at 0.05 ETH
Felix Arizona - Auction starts at 0.05 ETH
KG Park - Auction starts at 0.05 ETH
Special! Shiro Hideko - Fixed price (buy it now), only 0.05 ETH

Check out these super awesome new renders at: [url=https://opensea.io/collection/nm2-the-bad-guys]Nippon Marathon 2 - The Bad Guys - Collection | OpenSea
[/url]

So that's everything for now,

Thanks for reading, Amy and Andy

notes.title: Nippon Marathon 2 races to Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Heya everyone! 

We're super excites to share the news that the eagerly anticipated sequel to cult classic Nippon Marathon is coming soon to Kickstarter.

The campaign seeks to fund core development for Steam, Nintendo Switch, and an exclusive Arcade edition (published by exA-Arcadia). 

Stretch goals include (but not limited to) a visual novel Inspired story, as well as localisation, Steam Workshop implementation and the in-demand online mode. 

“It's been heartwarming to be bombarded by requests for Nippon Marathon 2 and so Kickstarter seems like the perfect place to fund the project, that way we can make a game that you, the community, want to play”, says lead developer Andy Madin.”There’s an intense desire from our fanbase to bring the Nippon Marathon online and this campaign can make that a reality.”

[previewyoutube=RblA_1i0wRI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Follow the Kickstarter: [/b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/onionsoupinteractive/nippon-marathon-2 ]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/onionsoupinteractive/nippon-marathon-2 [/url][/h1]


[b]About Nippon Marathon 2[/b]
Nippon Marathon 2 is the ultimate "Bakage" (Japanese for "Stupid Game"). Players race across a bizarre obstacle course until only one player remains. Skill and chaos are united in one wonderful experience. Last time you raced across Japan, this time you take on the world. This is Nippon Marathon 2 - the Brave World Tour!

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New and improved cast of crazy characters
[*] Silly physics abilities including the “grip” ability, grab your opponent and see what happens.
[*] Touka Koukan (equivalent exchange) - Players’ “popularity score” will make or break you in the Nippon Marathon; everything influences your popularity, whether that be for better or worse! 
[*] Brand new courses set around the world including London, the USA, France and more!
[*] Amazing new character specific B-Moves, such as Elizabeth Nishibori’s “Unicorn Rage”
[*] New weapons, such as the shuriken style STAR FRUIT. 
[*] Specific stats and animations for each character!
[*] All new back stories including how Snuguru Maestro became Elon Mus--- wait, what?
[*] Minigames and Party Games return! 
[*] An amazing soundtrack is back to soothe and/or excite your ears!
[/list]

Backers can choose from a range of rewards, from becoming beta testers to exclusive sustainable merchandise, including a backer exclusive T-Shirt.
 
To be notified when the campaign goes live and to be one of the first backers, register your interest on [b]Nippon Marathon 2’s Pre-Launch Page[/b]: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/onionsoupinteractive/nippon-marathon-2]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/onionsoupinteractive/nippon-marathon-2.[/url]

notes.title: Action Packed UEDI: Shadow of the Citadel Demo Crash Lands onto Steam Today
notes.notes:
[b]16 June 2020, London, UK[/b] - Indie dev Onion Soup Interactive announced today that a time limited demo of UEDI: Shadow of the Citadel will be playable during the Summer edition of the Steam Game Festival (16 June 2020 - 22 June 2020).

In UEDI: Shadow of the Citadel players will shoot and loot their way through a huge open world ARPG featuring a colourful 80's anime aesthetic and soundtrack. The good news is players will get a 20+ minute taste of what's to come in this awesome time-limited demo!

[previewyoutube=xrmuQlMPWrY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[b]Demo Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Meet the female-protagonist as she crashes onto a mysterious land.
[*] Begin to unravel the mysteries of the evil dictator HAZUKI.
[*] Engage in real-time combat with enemies that react tactically to your actions.
[*] Loot and scavenge for supplies and spare parts to top up ammo and fix machines.
[/list]

[b]Dev Live Stream and Discord Q&A:[/b]
To celebrate this playable slice of UEDI: Shadow of the Citadel the developers invite players to join their Dev Live Stream and Discord Q&A on June 20 at 4pm (BST)/ 8am (PDT)/ 11am (EDT), where future features will be revealed including player customisation, story characters and drivable vehicles. 

Onion Soup encourages players to set a reminder for the Dev Live Stream and Discord Q&A and help support UEDI: Shadow of the Citadel by adding the game to their Steam Wishlist via the Steam store page:  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236630/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236630/[/url]

[b]Press Assets[/b]
[url=https://www.onionsoupinteractive.com/uedi-press-kit]https://www.onionsoupinteractive.com/uedi-press-kit[/url]

[b]About Onion Soup Interactive[/b]
Onion Soup Interactive is made up of Andy and Amy: the nomad developers with no fixed abode! Their love of adventure and pushing boundaries is what makes them tick and it’s why they want to create unique experiences; everyone is welcome to join them for the ride. Andy Madin is the sole developer, Amy Madin is the community manager and costume designer for UEDI. They draw from gaming’s rich history to create truly original experiences: how else could the existence of Nippon Marathon really be explained? 
Learn more at [url=http://www.onionsoupinteractive.com]http://www.onionsoupinteractive.com[/url]

[b]Press Contact[/b]
amymadin@onionsoupinteractive.com

notes.title: Our Statement
notes.notes:
In UEDI: Shadow of the Citadel players will shoot and loot their way through a huge Open World Action RPG featuring a colourful 80's anime aesthetic and soundtrack and the good news is you'll get a 20+ minute taste of what's to come in this awesome time-limited demo!

The game world is littered with discoverable tales the player can piece together to understand the planet's violent past. Scavenged items and spare parts can be used by the player to interact with in-game devices and contraptions in order to solve puzzles. Exploration, looting and crafting are key to survival.

Players will take on the dictator HAZUKI and his army of mechs by engaging them in satisfying realtime combat. HAZUKI's machines are relentless in their pursuit of UEDI and the rebels. In this demo you'll encounter two types of enemy, the menacing PARTITE and the dangerous airborne DRO.

During combat the in-game radar informs the player of their combat status. CAUTION when enemies are close by. DANGER for active combat situations and HUNTED when new waves of enemies are incoming.

To even the odds the player must unleash the full potential of UEDI's NanoSuit. Each suit can be levelled up to gain new suit abilities and these abilities will be revealed as the game's development progresses. We'll be showcasing the progress on these suits and abilities during our live stream.

A loadout system enables players to customise UEDI's appearance and configure each suit with specific equipment allowing for dynamic approaches to gameplay without the need for constant inventory management. We'll be showing some of these features in our live stream too.

The game's story is delivered through fully animated cut-scenes and in-world conversations with NPCs, you'll get a taste of the story from this demo.

When you play through the demo we think you'll find it hard to believe we're such a super small team (just two of us and only one is a developer) and we're confident you'll enjoy your time with UEDI thoroughly!

notes.title: Dev Live Stream and Discord Q&A
notes.notes:
Shoot and loot your way through our 80's anime styled Action RPG as UEDI. She's a hot headed reporter on a mission to expose the truth behind the interplanetary lockdown but as HAZUKI the dictator tightens his grip she'll need to join the rebellion and unlock the full power of the experimental Nano Suit.

[h3]Playthrough[/h3]
We'll be playing through the demo and commenting as we go. You'll get insight into future planned development and how the Steam game Festival content relates to the bigger picture.

[h3]Character Reveal[/h3]
Join us as we lift the lid on some of the major characters in the world of UEDI. We'll be showing character models and other fun stuff too.

[h3]Outfits[/h3]
Wouldn't you love to be able to change your outfit at the press of a button? And what if each outfit came with specific abilities? We'll be showing you our plans for UEDI's NanoSuit, how exciting!

[h3]Vehicles[/h3]
There are plenty of wrecked vehicles littering the open world of UEDI: Shadow of the Citadel, we'll be showing you an early build where they can be repaired and used to get around!

[h3]Q&A[/h3]
We'll mosey on over to our DISCORD ([url=http://bit.ly/OnionSoupInteractiveDiscord]http://bit.ly/OnionSoupInteractiveDiscord[/url]) where you're cordially invited to join us and fire off questions or just have a lovely chat. Sounds nice huh?

[previewyoutube=Tq1A_lKmz_U;full][/previewyoutube]


Please join us, it will be super fun.

Andy & Amy
[i]Onion Soup interactive[/i]
